verdict.rationale: An IAM platform could plausibly offer event-triggered rules or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-definable event-to-action automation. Brute-force lockout is a fixed built-in protection, not a rule the user defines. Authorization policies (JS, time-based, regex) decide access rather than trigger actions. 'Customize through code' is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
